domainView.description: A custom domain: a hostname this node serves under its owner's brand (their place.stream.branding.brand record keyed by the hostname) instead of the node's own.

hostname.description: The custom domain, lowercase, without scheme or port.

owner.description: Account whose brand record styles the domain, and who may change it.

brand.description: The broadcaster ID the domain's branding is read and written under (did:web:<hostname>).

record.description: The brand record the domain follows.

recordCid.description: Version of the record the node last applied.

syncedAt.description: When the node last pulled the record.

syncError.description: Why the last pull failed, if it did.
